title: This money lost 99% in 10 years. Top 3 G20 currency crashes
headline: This money lost *99%*
description: Which G20 country's money lost the most against the US dollar since 2015? Guess before number one. Real World Bank exchange-rate data, 2015 vs 2025.
source: World Bank, official exchange rate (local currency per US$, period average), 2015 and 2025, G20 countries, data.worldbank.org/indicator/PA.NUS.FCRF

segments.text: This money lost ninety-nine percent in ten years. Which country?

props.kicker: Value lost against the US dollar

segments.text: Number three is Brazil. Over forty percent gone.
Number two is Turkey. Ninety-three percent.
Number one is Argentina. Over ninety-nine percent.
In 2015, one dollar got you nine pesos. Now it gets you twelve hundred forty-one.
How much has your money lost?
